title: ICE arrests 23-year-old UC Berkeley student and asylum seeker at San Francisco airport, attorney says
blurb: ICE arrested a 23‑year‑old UC Berkeley student and asylum seeker at San Francisco airport; the student claims prior gender‑based violence in Colombia.

title: Supreme Court rejects Trump’s push for California to set aside thousands of disputed mail ballots
blurb: Supreme Court declined to intervene in California’s effort to set aside mail ballots for 20,000 voters flagged as likely noncitizens, with no dissents.

title: In community-partnered research, UC Berkeley was a trailblazer. Today it’s a powerhouse.
blurb: UC Berkeley pioneered community-partnered research, now a leading institution, collaborating with communities to impact global issues.

title: Alameda County’s Election Day rules may block news coverage of voting, civil rights groups warn
blurb: Alameda County issued election‑day guidelines that could prevent press coverage at polling places, prompting civil‑rights groups to raise concerns.

title: In defense of dinner parties, and my favorite bite of the week
blurb: People report a decline in dinner parties; reporter Skylla Mumana begins a column promoting hosting friends at home.

title: Berkeley City Council District 8: Elmwood housing plan takes center stage
blurb: Berkeley City Council District 8 debates Elmwood housing plan; incumbent Mark Humbert supports limited version, challengers Mari Mendonca and Michael Wallman seek to scrap it.

title: ¿Puedo ser tu novio? Sunset proposal in waterfront Berkeley park draws curious onlookers
blurb: Sunset proposal at a waterfront park in Berkeley drew curious onlookers, as reporters witnessed the Cal couple’s romantic moment.

title: 6 Berkeley restaurants, shops burglarized early Sunday
blurb: Six Berkeley restaurants and shops burglarized Sunday; windows smashed, cash drawers stolen, police say, incidents may be related.

blurb: Five labs independently dosed mice with psilocybin; results showed mixed, modest reproducibility of reported behavioral effects.
